description: This file defines the Migration class for version 5.6.1 of the OrangeHRM system, responsible for updating certain display field class names within the system's database schema during migration.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: Handles the migration to version 5.6.1 by updating display field class names in the database.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Performs migration updates, specifically calling updateDisplayFieldClassNames to modify display field class names.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the version string of this migration, which is '5.6.1'.

methods.name: updateDisplayFieldClassNames
methods.description: Retrieves display field IDs by alias and updates their class names to appropriate report display field classes.

methods.name: getDisplayFieldIdFromFieldAlias
methods.description: Fetches the display field ID from the database for a given field alias name.

methods.name: updateDisplayFieldClassById
methods.description: Updates the class name of a display field in the database by its ID.
